chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea, then both copies of Water's Edge, all targeting Seapunk, for 21 total damage.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Thoma - Crimson Guard for 8 damage and 3 Block, reducing the incoming damage from 11 to 8.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 3 Block and therefore 3 HP this turn in exchange for dealing 13 more damage and leaving Seapunk at 1 HP.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Seapunk had telegraphed an attack of 22 or more, I would have played Thoma - Crimson Guard because its 3 Block would prevent the attack from being lethal.
